title: The Grothendieck-Lefschetz theorem for Normal Projective Varieties
exact_import: The classical smooth complete-intersection Picard theorem stated in the introduction, over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero: for a smooth projective complete intersection of dimension at least three in projective space, Pic is Z generated by O(1).
portions_inspected: Introduction before Section 1, including the base-field convention and the classical Picard statement; Section 1 opening discussion of divisors and Picard groups on smooth open subsets.
role: A proof input for generic ambient factoriality after removing the integral hyperplane at infinity. The paper's singular/general-member extension is not used.
